spec: wiki Methods/'Method - PC-ALM generative predictor (C2)', revision 2 (2026-10-17, after the 3-reviewer pass; user approved submitting)
model: generative predictor of pred_gpc.py (stage 1): residual top-down maps, zero start, T=400, 4000 steps, batch 256, unit observation weight
rule: PC-ALM: multipliers on every hidden residual incl. the top link to s; energy 0.5||z-mu0||^2 + rho/2 sum||r+lam||^2 + 0.5||s||^2; scaled method-of-multipliers dual step lam += r after every primal step (alpha=1, k_inner=1), never after the last; phase 2 at fixed s carries the seen views' (x, lam), unseen views start at topdown(s), lam=0
rev2_changes: rho is no longer selected by early prediction error (review D1/F3: the step for s scales 1/rho, so that rule picks rho=1, which does not converge to BP credit). Instead two ALM arms per depth, rho=1 and rho_hi, plus a rho_hi alpha=0 control (D2/D3).
rho_hi_and_T2: choose_rho.py on the diag_c2.py output (production pipeline, planted generator, weights x1/x2/x4): m(T2) = median over scale {1,2}, k {1,3}, c {0.5,1} of the all-view credit cosine vs the BP auto-decoder at the same s; rho_hi = smallest rho in {4,16,64} with m(100) >= 0.95 -> T2=100; else smallest with m(400) >= 0.95 -> T2=400; else rho=64, T2=400, flagged. rho with non-finite rows at scale <= 2 excluded. The chosen T2 applies to all three ALM-family arms of that depth.
c_selection: per depth and per rho in {1, rho_hi}: c in {0.25, 0.5, 1}, lowest val k=1 nmse after 800 of 4000 scheduled steps, 90/10 train split, seed 0; complete grid required; the alpha=0 control uses rho_hi's c

runs.per_depth: ALM rho_hi x seeds 0,1,2; ALM rho=1 x 0,1,2; alpha=0 at rho_hi x 0,1,2; BP auto-decoder and plain PC seeds 1,2 (seed 0 = stage 1, reused if det_check.py reproduces its first training row to 1e-3 relative)
runs.weights: final weights of every run saved; seed-0 ALM arms also at steps 1000, 2000

primary_endpoint: test k_seen k=1 clean nmse at T=400 (the k_seen row, not the pooled pairs row)

readings.parity: per-seed paired difference ALM - BP (same init and batch stream); parity if the mean paired difference lies within +-0.005 nmse and its 2-dof interval is reported; otherwise win/loss. n=3 is provisional.
readings.scaling: (ALM - BP) at d10 minus (ALM - BP) at d3, paired by seed; plus ALM d10 vs d3 alone. Depth is confounded with width (600 vs 256), stated.
readings.multipliers: ALM rho_hi vs alpha=0 rho_hi, paired: the multipliers help if ALM is lower by more than 0.005 nmse
readings.credit: logged on a fixed probe batch every 250 steps, k=1 and k=3, all/seen/unseen views: 'holds' if the median over steps >= 1000 of the all-view k=1 cosine is >= 0.95; drift = that median minus the step-1 value; rho=1 vs rho_hi drift compared paired by seed
readings.belief: s_dist_ad against a settled auto-decoder belief (c=1, T=2000)

failures: a run is retried at c/2 then c/4 on divergence or blow-up (c_used recorded and flagged); a cell that still fails counts as a failure of that arm and is reported, never dropped silently; non-finite test rows are listed in the result
